# `armadad join`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

Join this machine to a cluster as a node. Get ADDR, TOKEN, and the CA hash
from `armada node join-token`. The CA hash pins the cluster CA, so a machine in
the middle cannot pose as the server. Afterwards, run `armadad agent`.

The token is read from --token-file, a hidden prompt, or stdin; never from
an argument, which would leak into shell history.

```
armadad join ADDR --ca-hash sha256:HEX [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--ca-hash string` | cluster CA hash, sha256:... |
| `--container-subnet string` | private IPv4 subnet for this node's containers (clusters without a cluster network; others give each node a subnet) (default `10.121.0.0/24`) |
| `--data-dir string` | directory for the node certificate (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
| `--node-name string` | node name (default: hostname) |
| `--private-ip string` | this node's private IP (default: the only private IPv4 address) |
| `--token-file string` | file holding the join token (default: prompt or stdin) |
